title: ResourceRef
description: Product-level wire identity for a resource. zone_id and path rules are owned by nexus-vfs and referenced by stable $id from the vendored projections; this schema composes them and adds product semantics (api_version, media type, digest, size). It never restates the underlying regex or path normalization.

zone_id.description: Existing identity reference (never a tenant-create validator); system/control refs require an explicit system contract/context.

digest.description: Algorithm-prefixed digest, e.g. sha256:... — never a bare hex string.

size_bytes.description: Decimal string on purpose: avoids the JavaScript safe-integer trap.

$comment: zone_id + path jointly form the identity. follow/mount/copy into a target zone re-authorizes. additionalProperties stays true: unknown optional fields are accepted and ignored under a supported major.
